summary:
Optimized color for a more realistic and vivid color performance.
Optimized auto exposure algorithm.
Optimized functions of QS button. Press once to switch between front screen and touchscreen camera view (press and hold to switch screens during recording). Press once and then again to change shooting modes. Press and hold to access playback. It is now more convenient to access playback when under water or when there is a case mounted on the camera.
